current_calibration.docs:
Enables current calibration configuration.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

energy_calibration.docs:
Enables energy calibration configuration.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

power_calibration.docs:
Enables power calibration configuration.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

voltage_calibration.docs:
Enables voltage calibration configuration.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

current.docs:
The current value of the sensor in Amperes. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

current_reference.docs:
**float**: The calibration parameter for current readings. Defaults to `17158.9201389365` as calculated using schema defaults.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

energy.docs:
Use the voltage value of the sensor in kWh. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

energy_reference.docs:
**float**: The calibration parameter for cumulative energy readings. Defaults to `6120.6267056536` as calculated using schema defaults.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

external_temperature.docs:
The external value of the sensor in °C. Often not connected and gives garbage data. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

internal_temperature.docs:
The internal temperature value of the sensor in °C. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

legacy_mode.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to use the legacy configuration from initial implementation. Defaults to `true` to prevent breaking change.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

power.docs:
The (active) power value of the sensor in Watts. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

power_reference.docs:
**float**: The calibration parameter for power readings. Defaults to `713.104696500825` as calculated using schema defaults.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

read_command.docs:
The byte used for the read commands when communicating with the BL0940. By default, it is set to `0x58` or `0x50` in `legacy_mode`.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

reference_voltage.docs:
**float**: The calibration parameter for Vref. Defaults to `1.218`.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

resistor_one.docs:
**float**: The calibration parameter for R1. Defaults to `0.51`.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

resistor_shunt.docs:
**float**: The calibration parameter for RL. Defaults to `1`.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

resistor_two.docs:
**float**: The calibration parameter for R2. Defaults to `1950`.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
Manually specify the ID of the UART Component if you want to use multiple UART buses.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

voltage.docs:
The voltage value of the sensor in Volts. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

voltage_reference.docs:
**float**: The calibration parameter for voltage readings. Defaults to `266013.136288998` as calculated using schema defaults.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*

write_command.docs:
byte used for the write commands when communicating with the BL0940. By default, it is set to `0xA8` or `0xA0` in `legacy_mode`.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#configuration-variables)*
